agendas.name: The Unending Tally
agendas.description: Each time a DESTROYER CULT unit destroys 2+ enemy units in a single battle round, it gains 2XP. Track per round.

agendas.name: Supremacy Through Annihilation
agendas.description: Pre-game: select up to 3 of your opponent's highest-points units as Annihilation targets. Each time a NECRONS unit destroys an Annihilation target, the destroying unit gains 2XP.

agendas.name: Territorial Imperative
agendas.description: Each time a NECRONS unit destroys an enemy unit that started the turn in objective range, the destroying unit gains 1XP. Before shooting, select a NECRONS INFANTRY unit in objective range outside your deployment zone to conquer it (no shoot/charge; once per objective): 2XP.

agendas.name: Inescapable Retribution
agendas.description: Pre-game: opponent selects a No Man's Land objective as the Dynastic Treasure. At end of Movement, a CHARACTER in range can attempt to reclaim (no shoot/charge). If still in range at next Command phase: success, remove marker. Reclaiming Character gains 4XP. Post-game: exchange 1 Crusade Relic for an eligible Necrons Relic.
